  <div class="case-study">
    <div class="case-study-left">
      <img

    <div class="case-study-right">
      <span class="cs-number">01 — Grace Blu Interiors</span>

      <h2 class="cs-title">The work was<br>world-class.<br><em>The world just<br>didn't know it yet.</em></h2>

      <div class="cs-tags">
        <span class="cs-tag">Creative Direction</span>
        <span class="cs-tag">Campaign Styling</span>
        <span class="cs-tag">Brand Refinement</span>
        <span class="cs-tag">Photography Curation</span>
        <span class="cs-tag">3 Years</span>
      </div>

      <p class="cs-pull">Grace Blu — a luxury interior design studio in Newport Beach — was producing spaces worthy of global recognition. The visual identity, the content, and the photography weren't yet telling that story.</p>

      <p class="cs-body">Over three years, EatUrMood embedded into the brand to change that. We directed styling campaigns, elevated and curated the photographer roster, refined the brand package, and shaped the visual language from the inside out.</p>

      <div class="cs-press">
        <svg class="cs-press-icon" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19 20H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10l6 6v8a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z"/><polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/><line x1="16" y1="13" x2="8" y2="13"/><line x1="16" y1="17" x2="8" y2="17"/><polyline points="10 9 9 9 8 9"/></svg>
        <p class="cs-press-text">The collaboration culminated in a feature in <strong>Architectural Digest Middle East,</strong> shot by <strong>Douglas Friedman</strong> — one of the most sought-after architectural photographers in the world.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="cs-metrics">
        <div class="cs-metric">

    <div class="case-study-right">
      <span class="cs-number">02 — Girl with the Garden Gate</span>

      <h2 class="cs-title"><em>Some brands<br>aren't built.</em><br>They're cultivated.</h2>

      <div class="cs-tags">
        <span class="cs-tag">Brand Activation</span>
        <span class="cs-tag">Logo & Crest</span>
        <span class="cs-tag">Visual Identity</span>
        <span class="cs-tag">Storytelling</span>
        <span class="cs-tag">Full Rebrand</span>
      </div>

      <p class="cs-pull">Girl with the Garden Gate is an exclusive horticulture service — one part botanical expertise, one part lifestyle aspiration. When they came to EatUrMood, they had something rare: a genuinely distinctive point of view. What they needed was a world to match it.</p>

      <p class="cs-body">We built the brand from the ground up. A hand-crafted crest. A refined color language rooted in the garden itself. A logo with the weight of legacy and the softness of something that actually grows. A storytelling framework that positions the brand not as a service, but as an invitation into a very particular kind of life.</p>

      <div class="cs-press">
        <svg class="cs-press-icon" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2L2 7l10 5 10-5-10-5z"/><path d="M2 17l10 5 10-5"/><path d="M2 12l10 5 10-5"/></svg>
        <p class="cs-press-text">A full brand activation — from identity to imagery — built to introduce a new kind of horticulture brand to the world. <strong>Launch forthcoming.</strong> The gate is about to open.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="cs-metrics">
        <div class="cs-metric">

<script>
  const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  reveals.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
</script>
